name: Junior (Student) Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital in a placement, at least one 2-hour shift a week. Some assignments have after-school, early evening or weekend shifts.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 15 to 18 with a reference from a teacher or school counselor. You must commit for one year.
duration: One-year commitment, 2-hour shift at least once a week
deadline_text: The page says junior recruitment opens from time to time during the year. No dates posted.
how_to_apply: The page lists these steps for all volunteers: a volunteer application, an in-person interview, health requirements, a background screening, General Orientation and training. It shows no junior application link or contact, so ask the hospital volunteer office.
notes: Confirm first: no contact or junior application link on the page. The page says the commitment is one year and that junior recruitment opens periodically.
